data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Khavar means 'hidden treasure'. This name is derived from the Quranic verse 'And they who have been given knowledge see that which you do not see'. It symbolizes the inner wisdom and spiritual wealth that is not visible to the world but is cherished by Allah. The name Khavar carries the meaning “Hidden Treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khavar usually hope their child will grow to embody hidden treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
